chapter: Ragtime music and Scott Joplin books
title: Scott Joplin red books and Frog Legs
summary: Tom bought four Scott Joplin red books, recalls Chris Kelly's cornet book, and says only Israel Garman could play Frog Legs; Ragtime Dance was the hardest music.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days
